sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.DOCU_TITLE, REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(A.DOCU_CONT, ' '), CHR(13), ''), CHR(10), '
') AS DOCU_CONT, A.USER_ID, A.USER_NM, TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS APP_DATE, GET_CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO(A.COMPANY) AS APPR_ID, A.IMAGE_KEY, B.KEY_1 AS GW_GA_NO, (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND TEXT1 = A.COMPANY) AS COMPANYID FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOMTRGW B WHERE A.COMPANY IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002') AND A.EXTIF_TP = 'NG' AND A.PASS_STATUS = '0' AND A.COMPANY = B.COM_CODE AND A.DOCU_NO = B.TARGET AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND C WHERE C.BUYER = A.COMPANY AND C.DOC_NO = A.DOCU_NO )

SELECT BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, CASE WHEN REQ_PRICE_TYPE = 'R' THEN '실적가' WHEN REQ_PRICE_TYPE = 'M' THEN '시장가' ELSE '목표가' END AS REQ_PRICE_TYPE, NVL(TO_CHAR(BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,'999,999,999,999,999'),' ') AS BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(ORIGIN_NAME,' ') AS ORIGIN_NAME, NVL(AGENT_NAME,' ') AS AGENT_NAME, NVL(TO_CHAR(ITEM_QTY,'999,999,999,999,999'),' ') AS ITEM_QTY, SPECIFICATION, NVL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BTOA_END_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD'),' ') AS BTOA_END_DATE, (SELECT NVL(CATEG_PATH,' ') FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND STD_CATEG_ID = A.CATEGORY_NO AND STATUS = 'C' ) AS CATEGORY_NO, NVL(BTOA_REMARK,' ') AS BTOA_REMARK, NVL(PRE_GR_FLAG,'N') AS PRE_GR_FLAG, NVL(MSDS_YN,'N') AS MSDS_YN
FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.GW_GA_NO = #GW_GA_NO# AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'NG'
ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ

SELECT DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE / 1000 FILE_SIZE ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_NAME ,DES_FILE_DIR FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = #IMAGE_KEY#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APL_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, APP_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10 ) SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.ORDER_NO, (SELECT NVL(LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = #COMPANY# AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID, A.USER_NM, #APPR_ID# AS KEY_1, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '2' THEN '9' WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '3' THEN '2' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) END AS KEY_2, '' AS KEY_3, '' AS KEY_4, '' AS KEY_5, '' AS KEY_6, '' AS KEY_7, '' AS KEY_8, '' AS KEY_9, '' AS KEY_10 FROM ICOGPASSLN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO#

INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APM_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, SUBJECT, CONTENTS, APP_USER_ID, APP_USER_NAME, APP_DATE, KEY_1, KEP_2, KEP_3, KEP_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, CREATE_DATM, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #COMPANY#, #DOCU_NO#, #DOCU_TITLE#, #CONTENTS:CLOB#, #USER_ID#, #USER_NM#, #APP_DATE#, #APPR_ID#, 'MROHW8914', 'RQ', #GW_GA_NO#, '', '', '', '', '', '', SYSDATE, 'N' )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, KEY_1 AS APPRID, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTENTS, B.USER_ID AS MAIL_USER_ID, B.USER_NAME_LOC AS MAIL_USER_NAME, (SELECT CMP.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMP WHERE CMP.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS MAIL_COM_NAME_LOC, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ADD_DATE, KEP_2 AS SYSTEMID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CD1.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS COMPANYID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN (SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.DEPARTMENT) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT3) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS FORMCODE FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOGDOCU C WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND A.KEY_9 IS NULL AND A.KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND A.CREATE_DATM > TRUNC(SYSDATE - 60) AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
AND B.USER_ID = A.APP_USER_ID
AND C.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND C.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 != '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID)
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 = '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID)
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND A SET KEY_7 = #RTN_MSG# , IF_FLAG = #RTN_FLAG# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#

sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO ICOMAPPT ( USER_ID, APP_PATH, SUBJECT, DEFAULT_FLAG, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID ) SELECT APP_USER_ID, 1, '기본결재선', 'Y', 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'MASTER', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'MASTER' FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE ICOMAPSE WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT APP_USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#) AND APP_PATH = '1'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO ICOMAPSE ( APP_PATH, USER_ID, APPR_ID, APPR_NAME, APPR_SEQ, GUBUN, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, STATUS ) SELECT 1, (SELECT APP_USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#), A.USER_ID, B.USER_NAME_LOC, CASE WHEN A.PASS_TP IN ('1','3') THEN ORDER_NO - 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN A.PASS_TP = '1' THEN 'C' WHEN A.PASS_TP = '3' THEN 'H' ELSE 'R' END, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'MASTER', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'MASTER', 'C' FROM ICOGPASSLN A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.COMPANY = #BUYER# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOC_NO# AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND A.ORDER_NO != 1 ORDER BY A.ORDER_NO
